# chrome-use — drive your real, logged-in Chrome from any AI agent

chrome-use lets any AI agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or your own scripts) drive the real Chrome you are already signed into. It reuses your existing login sessions and preserves that browser profile; detector results are specific to the tested conditions. Part of the *-use family by 郭立 (Guo Li / Leo / leeguoo).

## What it is
- A CLI plus a one-click browser extension that drives your already-logged-in Chrome over native messaging — no remote debugging port, no token, no remote server; everything stays on your machine.
- Works with any agent or CLI, not a single app.
- Each `--session` gets its own colored Chrome tab group, so multiple agents share one real browser without conflict.
- `chrome-use mcp` starts a stdio MCP server (12 core tools) for MCP-only hosts that can't run a shell command — Claude Desktop, ChatGPT connectors, n8n/Dify. Shell-capable coding agents should use the CLI directly instead.
- `chrome-use a11y` runs an offline axe-core audit of the active page or a URL, including iframe findings; MCP clients get the same capability through `chrome_use_a11y` in the `all` profile.

## Why it is different
- vs Playwright / Puppeteer / browser-use: a fresh context starts without your sessions, but these tools also support persistent profiles or existing-browser connections. Compare the actual setup. chrome-use reuses the session you already have.
- vs Claude's Chrome extension: that drives only Claude; chrome-use drives any agent or CLI.
- vs a raw `--remote-debugging-port`: Chrome 136 restricts remote debugging of the default profile. chrome-use never does (native messaging).

## Anti-detection (measured)
- CreepJS: 0% bot, 0% headless.
- No `Runtime.enable` CDP leak (rebrowser) — off by default.
- Permission list: see the current extension manifest in the repository.

## Install
- `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leeguooooo/chrome-use/main/install.sh | sh`
- Agent skills: `npx skills add leeguooooo/chrome-use -g`
